summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, exhibiting forms of warrants, pre-funded warrants, placement agent warrants, a registration rights agreement, and a securities purchase agreement dated August 16, 2026, with purchasers. These documents relate to a proposed PIPE-style financing, including common share purchase warrants and pre-funded warrants, with H.C. Wainwright & Co. as placement agent per an engagement agreement. No specific deal terms were provided. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special situation, and no change of control or strategic event is indicated.
